newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 19.91 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 19.91 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Wednesday, July 9, was fixed at 19.91 percent, or a fall of 36.75 basis points from 20.2775 percent, the rate for July 8, Banco de Mexico said on Tuesday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Wednesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
